lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in roughly vertical columns of three to four nodes. A central cluster forms a triangular arrangement with one primary node positioned superior to two horizontally aligned nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the high-intensity blobs, particularly visible in the mid-section where stripes pass through the center of vertically aligned spot clusters.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible running along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The vertical stripe patterns exhibit non-linear, wavy trajectories between the horizontal carinae, particularly visible in the central flank region.
